lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice contrasting present perfect and preterite in everyday updates.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues talk about recent experiences and specific past times.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Talking about experiences and completed events with appropriate time framing.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether they have tried a café or activity and what happened when one of them went there yesterday.

main_focus.name: present perfect versus preterite
main_focus.description: Use present perfect for general or recent experience and preterite for a completed event at a specific time.
model_examples: Igår gick jag dit efter jobbet.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use both tenses naturally, with 2-3 examples of each across the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: time expressions like igår and förra veckan

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Include time expressions that make the tense choice clear.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks if the other has tried a place or activity.
dialogue_shape.middle: They contrast general experience with one specific past visit.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether to try it together later.

target_complexity.repetition: contrast har plus supine and preterite with clear time markers

focus: whether the experience has happened before
the specific past event that is described
what decision is made about trying it later

sentence_focus: one present perfect sentence about experience
one present perfect question with har du
one preterite sentence with förra veckan
one sentence contrasting experience and a specific past event
